Messages.Author: Patrick Drapeau
Messages.Body:
> Sorry if this question has been asked before. Her goes...can I
> play Blood to Water before strikes are declared seeing that the
> card only states play before strike resolution? If so, can my
> opponent use a strike that costs blood (i.e. Cauldron of Blood,
> etc.) before the effects of Blood to Water kick in?
>
> Thanks in advance,
> Jim

The card says: "he or she BURNS 3(or 5) blood" Burning blood is not combat
damage. It takes effect immediatly. It cant be prevented. If the vampire
is still alive, you then go as normally to the strike resolution. Both
vampires can use strikes on this strike resolution. Yes, it is a wild
card. It had spread fear in my anemies hearts... hehehe

Patrick Drapeau

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
da...@spectra.net (Jim & Andrew Davis) writes:

>Sorry if this question has been asked before. Her goes...can I

>play Blood to Water before strikes are declared seeing that the

>card only states play before strike resolution? If so, can my
>opponent use a strike that costs blood (i.e. Cauldron of Blood,
>etc.) before the effects of Blood to Water kick in?

Yes, you may use it any time before strike resolution (including
before strikes are chosen, or even before maneuvers are made).

No, your opponent can't "respond" to Blood to Water with a strike
that he can no longer afford. There is no "fast-effect-stack" in
Jyhad/VtES: an effect resolves completely as it is played, with
the exception of action cards, which resolve when the action is
successful.
